items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: She’s a great singer and she tracked a bunch of standards and we played with her.

ctx.x: She’s a great singer and she tracked a bunch of standards and we played with her. And then I guess Gladys — well Gladys, I don’t know where she lives. I don’t think she lives in New York. She might have put the parts on in Los Angeles.

Yeah. You know it is interesting when you’re doing a record for a singer, I’ve done some studio work, and if no one is singing, especially from a piano player, like you’re thinking maybe I shouldn’t be playing here. What am I covering up potentially. And that’s a weird feeling.
